notes: NightWatchers (src/NightWatchers.sol) is NIGHT WATCHERS, symbol WATCH, the NIGHT FROGS Gen 2: a fully onchain ERC-721 (OpenZeppelin v5) on Ethereum mainnet, the only application contract of this launch. Constructor (address owner_, uint256 fee_): owner_ = 0x6c4c78f2c3bdf4c4318fe305fb1c8bc1694d19b5, written as the static address because the brief states the owner, whose one power is setRenderer(renderer, skin), callable exactly once and only when both addresses have code; fee_ = 2000000000000000000 (2e18 = 2 IMD), the immutable forge fee returned by fee(). Everything else is a constant in the bytecode: NIGHT FROGS 0x55b8c762f1b86fe1d5406edaaae0f8ecf3688a0c and its renderer 0x4D9BfbafE31eC18E9D3066F1475e24906d155D67 (read-only sources), IMD 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7, the BurnExecutor 0xe29386719C155B6847aD5a4E97C6674f10ffc750 (receives FEE/2 per forge), the treasury 0x6c4c78f2c3bdf4c4318fe305fb1c8bc1694d19b5 (receives FEE - FEE/2 per forge and the ERC-2981 5% royalty, 500 bps), the dEaD burn address, the 50 Night Watcher cap, the rarity words, the trait counts and the tier thresholds. The constructor makes no external call, so it deploys on an empty chain; the live contracts are only read at forge time. No tokens are pre-minted: forge(uint256[10] ids, uint8 minTier) burns 10 caller-owned NIGHT FROGS to 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD, moves 1 IMD to the BurnExecutor and 1 IMD to the treasury by transferFrom, and mints Night Watcher tokens 1..50 to the caller; a forge that includes NIGHT FROG #1 also mints token 0, The Captain (tier 6), once. Supply is at most 51. Transfers are plain ERC-721. The contract never holds a frog or IMD, is not upgradeable or pausable, has no ownership transfer, withdraw or ETH handling, and reverts on forge and preview until setRenderer has been called. The owner must call setRenderer with the separately ordered NightWatchRenderer and NightWatchSkin addresses after launch. Verification after deployment: Etherscan with constructor args abi-encoded as (address,uint256) = (0x6c4c78f2c3bdf4c4318fe305fb1c8bc1694d19b5, 2000000000000000000) and Sourcify; foundry.toml pins solc 0.8.26, cancun, optimizer 200 runs, bytecode_hash none, cbor_metadata false.
